text:
lina: quick thought — can we add an "actor recall" column to the audit export and a small change-heatmap in the console? thinking: exportable CSV/ndjson with resolved actor ids + human name, and a tiny sparkline heatmap per-tenant showing change density over time :thinking_face:

devon: +1 on export. main question is PII — we need opt-in for resolved names vs pseudonymized ids. otherwise we can include `actor_display_hint` field. :lock:

sam: for the heatmap: do we want it per-route, per-actor, or per-tenant? my vote: tenant-level by default, with hover drilldown to route buckets. small perf note: computing daily bins for large tenants could be heavy if we do it on-demand.

maria: for exports, suggested schema: `timestamp, tenant_id, route, change_type, actor_id, actor_display_hint, justification, export_source`. keep actor_display_hint nullable and add `actor_pseudonym` if opted-in. also we should add `resolved_by: system|user|identity-service` to indicate provenance.

lina: sounds good. UX ask: console heatmap should surface bursty activity and let SRE link to trace or logs. ideally clicking a heatmap cell opens a presigned download filtered to that time window.

devon: implementation plan idea: compute heatmap aggregate hourly in our analytics pipeline (clickhouse or kinesis->materialization), store 30 days. UI read path just queries materialized table. export uses the same stream but can stream ndjson linked to S3 presigned.

audit-bot: export job created: `export/actor-recall-2024-04-12` queued, includes `actor_display_hint` = false by default.

sam: small API debate: should the export endpoint accept `resolve_actors=true` which triggers on-the-fly resolution (costly) or require a precomputed resolution job? leaning toward precomputed mapping to avoid tail latency.

maria: also add a `redaction_mode` header: `none|mask_names|hash_ids` so exports can be compliant by default.

lina: ok next steps: (1) @devon do a quick perf spike for hourly heatmap materialization (2) @sam draft export schema and API params (3) @maria write recommended redaction defaults and compliance notes. I'll sync with legal on opt-in language.

devon: starting spike now, will post results by EOD. :rocket:

audit-bot: export job `export/actor-recall-2024-04-12` started at 1718504600, estimated size 1.2GB (tenant: examplecorp).
